old:
Fractional results (10.3–10.5).
The inherited fourth block proves the scalar beta normalization, the
Lebesgue integral representation of actual positive fractional powers, the literal resolvent-defect for-
mula, both printed norm constants and exact intertwining. The rectangular complex-Hilbert-space
semigroup proof substitutes those constants into Duhamel’s identity. The varying-space tower proof
gives summability of fractional-defect norms and uniform convergence of time-defect norm series
on bounded time intervals. Here “summable” means summable in norm. Operators with unrelated
codomains are not added together. A separate fixed-space theorem proves operator-series convergence
when such a sum is defined.
new: Fractional results (10.3–10.5). The formalization proves the scalar beta normalization, the Lebesgue integral representation of actual positive fractional powers, the literal resolvent-defect formula, both printed norm constants and exact intertwining. The rectangular complex-Hilbert-space semigroup proof substitutes those constants into Duhamel’s identity. The varying-space tower proof gives summability of fractional-defect norms and uniform convergence of time-defect norm series on bounded time intervals. Here “summable” means summable in norm. Operators with unrelated codomains are not added together. A separate fixed-space theorem proves operator-series convergence when such a sum is defined.

old:
Verification and numerical evidence.
The September 6 release records that the full pinned build,
project-wide axiom audit, all 54 companion tests and six verifier controls passed. No fresh Lean build
is asserted for this October edition. The 54 tests comprise the original 37 and 17 added boundary and
validation cases. The 19 numerical figure pairs are unchanged. The earlier 79-field numerical compari-
son remains historical evidence, not a rerun in that September 6 block. The September 12 visual release
subsequently records a numerical replay. Current October checks are reported separately in the final
package. Machine-readable source contracts, exact theorem targets, full logs and previous checked
ledgers accompany the source archive. Numerical tests are finite regressions and are not substitutes
for the Lean proofs.

The 54 tests comprise 37 original tests and 17 boundary and validation cases. The numerical records separately identify the 79-field comparison and the visual replay. Source contracts, exact theorem targets, logs and checked ledgers accompany the source files. Numerical tests are finite regressions and are not substitutes for the Lean proofs.

old:
5.5
Eckart–Young–Mirsky
Ordered diagonal spectral and Frobenius best-rank
bounds and isometric transfer are checked as sup-
port for 5.6. General SVD existence and the canonical
singular-values API theorem are outside this release.
7.5
CG convergence
The classical energy-error estimate is supplied. The for-
mal block proves monotonicity and replacement by a
certified condition bound, rather than proving the CG
algorithm or its classical convergence theorem.
8.2
Floating-point product model
Local error inequalities are supplied to exact normed-
ring propagation. IEEE rounding semantics and a device
implementation are not independently proved.
9.1
Simultaneous spectral decom-
position
Exact residual and off-diagonal certificates are proved
for a supplied finite self-adjoint projector family. A gen-
eral simultaneous-decomposition algorithm is not inde-
pendently formalized.
